author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, background, and game art
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets, Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com. Gunakan subject email: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Cantumkan jenis artwork, art style, ketersediaan, dan rate freelance.

source: Art in Public Places - Aurora, Colorado
author: Art in Public Places - Aurora, Colorado
title: $30,000 mural commission seeking Native American artists
content: The City of Aurora’s Art in Public Places Program is seeking Native American artists for a $30,000 mural commission at the Prairie Roots Educational Center within the Plains Conservation Center. The selected artist will create a mural across 14 interior eave surfaces, creating a cohesive visual experience that explores the history, culture and landscape of the plains. Opportunity Details: $30,000 project budget. Large-scale mural commission. Deadline: October 7, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. MT. Apply through CaFÉ via Creative West. The application is free.
